title: Spring Gentian
summary: An Arctic-alpine wildflower with vivid blue star-shaped blooms, thriving on Burren limestone far from its usual mountain habitats.
content:
An Arctic-alpine wildflower whose intense blue, star-shaped flowers are the best-known symbol of the Burren's flora. Rarely growing taller than a few centimetres, it flowers from April through June, opening fully only in bright sunlight.

Its presence here at near sea level, far from the mountain and tundra habitats it usually favours, is one of the Burren's defining ecological curiosities — thriving on thin, calcium-rich soil over bare limestone pavement.
